target_customer: Medicaid-eligible families in Michigan who want a relative paid to provide home care, plus the managed care organizations and insurers that pay the agency
problem: Millions of Americans give unpaid care to a loved one. Medicaid programs can pay relatives, but enrollment, scheduling and timekeeping paperwork is hard, and conventional agencies pay caregivers little.
business_model: Licensed home care agency billing Medicaid, managed care organizations, long-term care insurance and private pay, with AI agents running the back office
product_category: AI-enabled home care agency for family caregivers

competitors.name: Abby Care

competitors.traction_then: Reported in a secondary article as in eight states with about $15M 2025 revenue; Michigan not seen on its state list
competitors.funding_then: Reported valuation of $225M in the same secondary article, unverified

competitors.name: Momba Home Care
competitors.what: Helps Ohio families use Structured Family Caregiving, a Medicaid program paying relatives
competitors.traction_then: Local press describes service across Ohio

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly workflow automation, scheduling, timekeeping and Medicaid billing. The hard parts are regulatory licensing and payer integration, not software.

defensibility.rationale: A Michigan home care agency license and payer contracts add friction, but other agencies and Abby Care run the same Medicaid model and AI back office tooling is widely available.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found as of 2026-11; the company was only in its Summer 2026 batch.

market_need_then: Michigan Home Help pays individual caregivers about $17.13 per hour from 2026-01-01 and is described as an entitlement with need exceeding its scope. KFF notes Medicaid family caregiver supports are optional for states and under policy pressure. Demand for paid family caregiving is large but eligibility rules vary.

identity.logo: Circular mark with the Cova wordmark
identity.visual_style: Simple teal and white, phone mockups of the app and payroll
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, plain-spoken, family-centered; tagline Covered Anywhere, Covered Always

brand_strength.rationale: Only a few weeks old with no press about the brand. Search shows other companies named Cova or Cova Care in India, Nigeria and elsewhere, so the name is shared.

outcome_analysis: Cova is a very new Summer 2026 company with two founders from Palantir's healthcare team, running a licensed Michigan home care agency. No outcome yet. Key risks are Medicaid policy changes, payer contracting and imitators like Abby Care, while its edge is low overhead from AI back office work.
